column1: # Capture and crop tables for scripts/capture-readme.sh. Tab-separated; blank lines and '#' lines are ignored.
#       One capture. <tool> is widget-shot (first argument is the device tag; the output path is added after it)
#       or guihost (the plugin path and an output directory are added in front). Every argument is one argv word,
#       so a control name with spaces stays whole. '-' is the default 2560x1600x24 display. The scale (1.5), full
#       redraw, reduced motion and the lavapipe Vulkan driver are set by the script, not here.
#       One image of the README, cut from one capture ('-' keeps the whole frame). The rectangles are pixel
#       positions of the editor at 1.5x on the 1860x1101 (or taller, --height) capture, so a change to a
#       window's size or a card's place moves them: the script refuses a crop that runs off its frame, and
#       An image with a live scope or analyser in it, whose pixels vary a little from run to run under load.
#       --check calls it stale only when more than 8 percent of its pixels differ.
#       A setting; ${NAME} in a shot's arguments is replaced by it. An argument "@env:K=V" sets an environment
#       variable for that capture (FEATHERS_EXPLORE_ZOOM is how Explore is opened at a zoom).
#       An animated GIF from a shot's frames (widget-shot --explore-rotate writes <id>-rNN.png), each cropped and
#       scaled, one loop in <loop ms>, at most 3 MB.
#       The label of a card in collage-all-cards.png.
# --- settings every Explore capture shares (the Additive engine; the still at x1/3, the rotate GIF at its own GIF_ZOOM) ---
# 07-13 are the window shots below with one more pixel of the editor on every side.
# --- the expanded windows (the panel floating over the editor) ----------------------------------------------
